[LTIM.1.2.2] `year` is the full Gregorian year (`2024`, not
`'24` or `124`).

**A `Date` has the range of a `Time`.** A `Date` is one of the days whose
midnight in UTC is a representable `Time` ([LTIM.1.1.5]): `1677-09-22` through
`2262-04-11`, the day counts −106 751 through 106 751 from 1970-01-01
([LTIM.6.6]). A `Date` outside that range is never a silent wrap. A host call
that would admit one returns `DS_ERR_TIME_RANGE`; an operation in a rule whose
result falls outside it raises a `ComputationError` of kind `NOT_REPRESENTABLE`
([LERR.1.4.10]).
